tool_schemas.name: generateImageUrl
tool_schemas.description: Generates an image from the provided prompt using the selected image model and returns a URL pointing to the generated image, applying optional prompt enhancement and safety filtering plus any provided seed/size parameters. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prompt is missing/empty, width/height/limit values are out of range, or model/format options are not supported; raises NOT_FOUND if the requested model key does not exist in the image model catalog. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to use the requested model or safe mode setting, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or usage quotas are exceeded, and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE on upstream generation failures/timeouts.

prompt.description: The text description of the image to generate

model.description: Model name to use for generation (default: "flux"). Available options: "flux", "sdxl", "sd3", "sd15", "flux-schnell", "flux-dev"

enhance.description: Whether to enhance the prompt using an LLM before generating (default: true)

safe.description: Whether to apply content filtering (default: false)

tool_schemas.name: generateImage
tool_schemas.description: Generates an image from the provided prompt using the selected image model and returns the base64-encoded image payload along with the resolved generation settings (model/seed/size/enhance/safe). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prompt is missing/empty, width/height are invalid, format is not one of png/jpeg/jpg/webp, or model is not supported; raises NOT_FOUND if the requested model key does not exist in the image model catalog. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to use the requested model or settings, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or usage quotas are exceeded, and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE on upstream generation failures/timeouts.

prompt.description: The text description of the image to generate

model.description: Model name to use for generation (default: "flux"). Available options: "flux, "turbo" (sdxl),

enhance.description: Whether to enhance the prompt using an LLM before generating (default: true)

safe.description: Whether to apply content filtering (default: false)

outputPath.description: Directory path where to save the image (default: "./mcpollinations-output")

fileName.description: Name of the file to save (without extension, default: generated from prompt)

format.description: Image format to save as (png, jpeg, jpg, webp - default: png)

tool_schemas.name: listImageModels
tool_schemas.description: Lists image models from the model catalog, optionally filtered by status and vendor, and returns results sorted by sortBy/sortOrder. Results are paged with an opaque cursor: provide cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page, and limit controls the maximum number of models returned (default 50). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values or out-of-range limit, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the catalog, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when listing requests exceed rate or quota.

status.description: Filter image models by catalog status.

vendor.description: Filter image models by vendor name.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (opaque); from a previous response to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return (default: 50).

sortBy.description: Field to sort results by (default: sort_order).

tool_schemas.name: respondAudio
tool_schemas.description: Generates a text-to-speech audio response for the provided prompt using the selected voice and returns the generated audio artifact metadata (and any playback result when supported), honoring an optional seed. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prompt is missing/empty or the voice value is not supported, and NOT_FOUND if the requested voice key does not exist in the voice catalog. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to use the requested voice, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or usage quotas are exceeded, and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE on upstream TTS failures/timeouts.

prompt.description: The text prompt to respond to with audio

voice.description: Voice to use for audio generation (default: "alloy"). Available options: "alloy", "echo", "fable", "onyx", "nova", "shimmer", "coral", "verse", "ballad", "ash", "sage", "amuch", "dan"

tool_schemas.name: listAudioVoices
tool_schemas.description: Lists available text-to-speech voices from the voice catalog, optionally filtered by status and vendor, and returns results sorted by sortBy/sortOrder. Results are paged with an opaque cursor: provide cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page, and limit controls the maximum number of voices returned (default 50). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values or out-of-range limit, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the catalog, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when listing requests exceed rate or quota.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (opaque); from a previous response to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of voices to return (default: 50).

sortBy.description: Field to sort results by (default: sort_order).

tool_schemas.name: respondText
tool_schemas.description: Generates a text response for the provided prompt using the selected text model and returns the model output along with the resolved generation settings (model/seed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prompt is missing/empty or model is not supported, and NOT_FOUND if the requested model key does not exist in the text model catalog. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to use the requested model, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or usage quotas are exceeded, and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE on upstream text generation failures/timeouts.

prompt.description: The text prompt to generate a response for

model.description: Model to use for text generation (default: "openai"). Available options: "openai", "anthropic", "mistral", "llama", "gemini" - use listTextModels to see all models

tool_schemas.name: listTextModels
tool_schemas.description: Lists text models from the model catalog, optionally filtered by status and vendor, and returns results sorted by sortBy/sortOrder. Results are paged with an opaque cursor: provide cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page, and limit controls the maximum number of models returned (default 50). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values or out-of-range limit, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the catalog, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when listing requests exceed rate or quota.

status.description: Filter text models by catalog status.

vendor.description: Filter text models by vendor name.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (opaque); from a previous response to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return (default: 50).

sortBy.description: Field to sort results by (default: sort_order).

tool_schemas.name: getGenerationRequest
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single generation request by id, including its persisted, resolved parameters and current lifecycle status. Returns NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the calling client; raises FORBIDDEN if the calling client is suspended/deleted.

tool_schemas.name: listGenerationRequests
tool_schemas.description: Lists generation requests for the calling client, optionally filtered by status/modality/toolName/modelKey and time window. Results are paged with an opaque cursor: provide cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page, and limit controls the maximum number of requests returned (default 50). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values or out-of-range limit; raises FORBIDDEN if the calling client is suspended/deleted or rate-limited.

toolName.description: Filter by tool name that created the request.

modelKey.description: Filter by resolved model/voice key stored on the request.

createdAfter.description: Filter requests created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

createdBefore.description: Filter requests created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (opaque); from a previous response to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to return (default: 50).

sortBy.description: Field to sort results by (default: created_at).

tool_schemas.name: cancelGenerationRequest
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running generation request by id. Transitions status from queued->cancelled or running->cancelled; refuses cancellation once the request is succeeded/failed/cancelled. Returns the updated generation request. Raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the calling client; raises CONFLICT if the status transition is not allowed; raises FORBIDDEN if the calling client is suspended/deleted.

reason.description: Optional cancellation reason for audit logging.

tool_schemas.name: getIdentity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity (client) as resolved from the presented credential, including status, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption snapshots. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no/invalid credential is provided; raises FORBIDDEN if the client is suspended/deleted.

includeUsage.description: Whether to include current-day usage totals and rolling rate-limit window counters (default: true).

metadata.name: MCPollinations Multimodal Server
metadata.description: This backend powers a multimodal generation gateway that can create images (as URLs or base64), generate text responses, and produce text-to-speech audio.
